title: A constant slice residue model restricts to the actual finite free sheaf
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with residue field $k$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme $S$, an open $U$, and a normalized coefficient restriction datum $d$ [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over the constant residue ring on the small pro-etale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If its localized sheaf on the slice over $U$ is isomorphic to the constant module with model $k^r$ [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf], then the exact ordinary finite-coefficient restriction specified by $d$ is isomorphic to the actual free residue sheaf topCellResidueFree of rank $r$ [lem-sf-complete-top-residue-cell-cone]. The assertion allows rank zero and an empty open.

proof.text: Use the concrete sliceFrom functor to precompose localized module sheaves to the pro-etale site of U, with scalars transported by d.finite 0. It preserves finite limits sectionwise and is additive, hence preserves finite biproducts. The coefficient ring isomorphism makes its canonical map from the local unit to the restricted unit invertible.

The model sheafification functor is additive. Identify k^r with the finite biproduct of r copies of k; its sheafification is the biproduct of the coefficient units by the constant-unit comparison. Apply restriction to the supplied model isomorphism and this biproduct description. Reindex the coproduct by the equivalence from ULift (Fin r) to Fin r to obtain precisely topCellResidueFree. This proof also handles r=0.

theorem sf_clopen_residue_free_restriction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (U : S.Opens)
    (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction.{u, u} l E S U)
    (F : scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E S 0) (r : ℕ)
    (hF : Nonempty (F.over (ProEt.mk U.ι) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOverOfUniverses S
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1) (ProEt.mk U.ι)
        (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))
          (Fin r → ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))))) :
    Nonempty (topCellResidueFree.{u} l E U.toScheme r ≅
      (sfClopenModuleRestriction U _ _ (d.finite 0)).obj F)
